_comment: Reference Pterodactyl egg for running the Open Discord Bridge as its own server (a bridge-only container). Configure via the variables below (env-var config mode). For the sidecar model — bridge co-located with Factorio in one container — use deploy/Dockerfile.sidecar with your Factorio egg instead. Adjust docker_images to your published image.
name: Open Discord Bridge
author: bits-orio@users.noreply.github.com
description: Mirrors Factorio chat and events to Discord. Runs as a standalone bridge container; configured entirely from environment variables.

variables.name: Config mode
variables.description: 'none' forces env-var mode: the bridge ignores any bridge.yaml, so a stray or panel-written file can never disable these variables. Clear it only to use a hand-written bridge.yaml.

variables.name: Built-in commands
variables.description: Ship the built-in Discord command set (!players + account linking: !link, !unlink, admin !links/!unlink-player/!unlink-all).

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: Bot token from the Discord developer portal.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: Factorio RCON password (must match the server).

variables.name: RCON address
variables.description: Factorio RCON host:port. Loopback for a sidecar; the server's network address for a separate container.

variables.name: Events file path
variables.description: Path to the companion mod's events.jsonl (local path, or remote path when transport is sftp).

variables.name: Discord channel ID
variables.description: Catch-all channel for all events (shortcut). For per-event routing use ODB_ROUTES instead.

variables.name: Transport
variables.description: How the bridge reads the events file: local (shared filesystem) or sftp (remote).

variables.name: SFTP host
variables.description: SFTP host:port (only when transport is sftp).

variables.name: SFTP user
variables.description: SFTP username (only when transport is sftp).

variables.name: SFTP key path
variables.description: Path to the SFTP private key inside the container (only when transport is sftp).

variables.name: Control API token
variables.description: Bearer token for the Control API (required if enabled).

variables.name: Admin role IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated Discord role IDs treated as admin (for admin-only commands).

variables.name: Admin user IDs
variables.description: Comma-separated Discord user IDs treated as admin.
